files.html:
0.1.7 Change Log

  • Fixed numerous bugs in the battle engine
  • Fixed an issue with overlapping battle sounds
  • Fixed battles freezing when using the Switcher
  • Added custom battle slot functionality
  • Removed unnecessary encounter policies
  • Cleaned up UI issues, including duplicate buttons
  • Fixed a bug where trainers wouldn’t dash
